<section_guide number="2" title="MVP Goals and Scope">
<purpose>Set the exact PoC boundary and the results that will validate the product idea.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What single user-and-outcome hypothesis should this PoC test?
2. Which user abilities must the PoC demonstrate?
</questions>

<workflow>
Propose a concise Feature list with F1, F2, and so on from the confirmed scope. Each Feature name
must describe a user ability and include one observable result. Ask the user to confirm the complete
list before saving it. Record one to three success criteria and preserve supplied values exactly.
Ask about Out of Scope only when the user has an explicit exclusion or the proposed boundary is
materially ambiguous. It is optional and must not be invented to complete the section.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the hypothesis, complete Feature list, and success criteria before saving. Out of Scope may remain empty.</completion>
</section_guide>
